note: Pet House facts and the L.A.S.S.I stat line come from the material supplied by the site owner. Every other pet is listed by name and unlock order only, because its stats could not be confirmed.

facts.label: Upgrade cost
facts.text: Every Pet House upgrade costs Dark Elixir.

facts.label: One at a time
facts.text: Only one pet can be upgrading in the Pet House at once.

facts.label: Instant finish
facts.text: A Book of Heroes or a Hammer of Heroes finishes a pet upgrade instantly.

facts.label: Speed up
facts.text: Pet Potions speed pet upgrades up.

facts.label: Pets added per Town Hall
facts.text: Town Hall 15 adds 4 pets, Town Hall 16 adds 2, Town Hall 17 adds 1 and Town Hall 18 adds 1, for 12 in total.

facts.label: Heroes only
facts.text: Pets are assigned to heroes and fight alongside them.

pairings.note: Suggestions, not a tier list. They assume a maxed Pet House and a pet you actually own; a lower-level pet may be worse than a maxed one you already have.

items.reason: A tanking pet in front of the King spreads the damage he takes.
A fast ground pet follows a walking Queen without lagging behind.
An air pet stays with a support hero who often trails the main push.
A pet with its own healing or speed suits a hero who hunts defences alone.
An air hero and an air pet keep the same path through the base.
A melee hero benefits from a second body taking hits beside him.
